questions.stem: 雖然只是匆匆經過，在車站看見公共藝術仍能讓旅客放鬆心情。
questions.answer: Although travelers are just passing by, seeing public art at the station can still help them relax.
accepted_answers: Even though travelers only pass by in a hurry, seeing public art in the station can still help them relax.
Though travelers are only hurrying past, seeing public art at the station can still make them feel relaxed.

questions.stem: 這些作品如此有創意，要在等車時感到無聊其實很難。
questions.answer: These works are so creative that it is actually hard to feel bored while waiting for the train.
accepted_answers: These works of art are so creative that it is difficult to feel bored while waiting for a train.
They are such creative works that it is hard to get bored while waiting for trains.

patterns: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞

1.explanation_zh: 「雖然…仍…」英文只用一個連接詞 although／though／even though，主要子句不再加 but，「仍」用 still 表達。中文第一個子句省略了主詞，英文要補上 travelers，後面再用 them 指回旅客。「在車站看見公共藝術」是動作當主詞，用動名詞片語 seeing public art at the station，後面接 can still help them relax（help＋人＋原形動詞）；public art 是不可數名詞，不加 s。
1.strategy_zh: 中文「雖然…（但）仍…」在英文只能留 although；先找出真正的主詞——這一句是「看見公共藝術」這個動作。
hints: 切成四段：雖然只是匆匆經過／在車站看見公共藝術／仍能讓旅客／放鬆心情
標的詞彙：traveler（旅客）、public（公共的）、art（藝術）、station（車站）、still（仍然）、relax（放鬆）
句型框架：Although + S + V, V-ing … + can still help + O + VR

2.explanation_zh: 「如此有創意，（以至於）…」是結果句型 so + 形容詞 + that + 子句；後面若接名詞就用 such creative works that …。that 子句裡「要在等車時感到無聊其實很難」的主詞是「感到無聊」這個動作，英文用虛主詞 it is hard to feel bored。「等車時」可以寫 while waiting for the train（連接詞＋分詞）；「感到無聊」是人的感受，用 bored。
evidence: 要在等車時感到無聊其實很難
2.strategy_zh: 「如此…（以至於）…」先想 so … that；「要…很難／很容易」先想 It is + adj. + to VR。
hints: 切成四段：這些作品如此有創意／等車時／感到無聊／其實很難
標的詞彙：work（作品）、creative（有創意的）、bored（感到無聊的）、wait（等待；wait for）、train（火車）
句型框架：S + be + so + adj. + that + it is + adj. + to VR … while V-ing …

patterns.frame: Although/Though/Even though + S + V, S + V（不再加 but）

accepted: Although travelers are just passing by
Even though travelers only pass by in a hurry
Though travelers are only hurrying past
Although travelers are only passing through
Although travelers just pass by quickly
Even though passengers are just passing by
Even if travelers are only passing by

common_errors.right: Although travelers are just passing by
common_errors.explanation_zh: 中文省略主詞，英文的讓步子句要補上主詞（旅客 travelers）。

common_errors.wrong: Although travelers are just passing by, but
common_errors.right: Although travelers are just passing by,
common_errors.explanation_zh: although 和 but 不能同時用，英文只留一個連接詞。

accepted: seeing public art at the station
seeing public art in the station
seeing public art at train stations
looking at public art in the station
seeing the public art at the station

common_errors.wrong: see public art at the station can
common_errors.right: seeing public art at the station can
common_errors.explanation_zh: 動作當主詞要用動名詞 seeing，不能用原形動詞。

common_errors.wrong: seeing public arts at the station
common_errors.right: seeing public art at the station
common_errors.explanation_zh: art 指藝術作品的總稱時是不可數名詞，不加 s。
let 後面直接接原形動詞，不加 to；也可以寫 help them relax。
「放鬆心情」英文直接用 relax 或 feel relaxed，不說 relax their mood。
人「感到放鬆」用 relaxed；relaxing 是「令人放鬆的」。

traps.literal_error: Although just passing by in a hurry, but seeing public art at the station can still let travelers relax.
traps.explanation_zh: 讓步子句沒有主詞，又把「雖然…仍…」譯成 although … but，兩處都會扣分；英文要補主詞 travelers，而且只用 although。

traps.literal_error: At the station see public art can still let travelers relax their mood.
traps.explanation_zh: 「在車站看見公共藝術」是動作當主詞，英文要用動名詞片語 seeing public art at the station，不能用原形動詞或介系詞片語開頭。

1.restructuring_zh: 「在車站看見公共藝術」是動作當主詞，英文用動名詞片語 seeing public art at the station 當主詞；「雖然只是匆匆經過」沒有主詞，要補上 travelers，主要子句再用 them 指回旅客。

references: These works are so creative that it is actually hard to feel bored while waiting for the train.

patterns.frame: S + be + so + adj. + that … ／ such + adj. + N + that …

patterns.label_zh: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞
patterns.zh_trigger: 要在等車時感到無聊其實很難

accepted: These works are so creative that
These works of art are so creative that
They are such creative works that
These artworks are so creative that
These pieces are so creative that

common_errors.wrong: These works are very creative that
common_errors.right: These works are so creative that
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「如此…以至於」用 so + 形容詞 + that，不用 very。

common_errors.wrong: These works are so creation that
common_errors.right: These works are so creative that
common_errors.explanation_zh: creation 是名詞；so 後面接形容詞 creative。

common_errors.wrong: They are so creative works that
common_errors.right: They are such creative works that
common_errors.explanation_zh: 後面有名詞時用 such + 形容詞 + 名詞 + that；so 後面只接形容詞或副詞。

accepted: while they are waiting for the train
while they wait for the train

common_errors.explanation_zh: while 後面省略主詞時用 V-ing（while waiting），不然要寫完整子句 while they wait …。
人「感到無聊」用 bored；boring 是「令人覺得無聊的」。

common_errors.wrong: is actually hard to feel bored
common_errors.right: it is actually hard to feel bored
common_errors.explanation_zh: 中文「要…很難」沒有主詞，英文用虛主詞 it 開頭：it is hard to VR。

traps.literal_error: These works are so creative that it is hard to feel boring while waiting for the train.
traps.explanation_zh: 「感到無聊」描述人的感受，要用 bored；寫成 boring 意思變成「讓人覺得無聊」。

traps.zh: 要在等車時感到無聊其實很難
traps.literal_error: These works are so creative that want to feel bored when waiting the train is actually hard.
traps.explanation_zh: 「要…很難」的「要」不是 want；整個動作是主詞，英文用虛主詞 it is hard to feel bored …。

bonus.text: So creative are these works that it is actually hard to feel bored while waiting for the train.
bonus.explanation_zh: 把 so + 形容詞移到句首，後面的 be 動詞與主詞倒裝，語氣更強，屬加分寫法；一般寫 These works are so creative that … 就能拿滿分。

2.restructuring_zh: 「要在等車時感到無聊其實很難」是動作當主詞，英文以虛主詞 it 開頭：it is actually hard to feel bored while waiting for the train。

1.translation: Although travelers are only passing through in a hurry, seeing public art at the station can still help them relax.
1.explanation_zh: 「雖然…仍…」用 Although 引導讓步子句，主要子句用 still；「在車站看見公共藝術」是動作當主詞，用動名詞 seeing；「放鬆心情」譯 help them relax。

2.translation: These works are so creative that it is actually hard to feel bored while waiting for a train.
2.explanation_zh: 「如此…，要…很難」用 so…that 結構，that 子句內再用 it is hard to V；「等車」在車站情境下譯 waiting for a train（也可能是公車，略有歧義）。

1.translation: Although travelers are only passing through in a hurry, seeing public art at the station can still help them relax.
1.explanation_zh: 「雖然……仍」用 although 讓步子句，主句用動名詞 seeing 當主詞，「仍能」用 can still；「放鬆心情」用 help them relax。

2.translation: These works are so creative that it is actually hard to feel bored while waiting for a train.
2.explanation_zh: 「如此……要……」用 so ... that 結果子句；「要在等車時感到無聊其實很難」用虛主詞 it is hard to feel bored，while waiting 表同時。
